Jet speed against the bus voltage: v0 = 10.0 m/s × (V / 22.2 V)^0.80 (fit from 21 V and 25.2 V, ASSUMED speed ~ voltage).

## Fire capacity (recommended pump and nozzle)

- Water flow 7.0 g/s. If all of it evaporates, it takes 18 kW. This is an upper limit: on a real fire much of the water runs off.
- At the hand-application rates of 9 to 15 L/(m2 min), the flow covers 280 to 467 cm2 of fire floor area, a square of 17 to 22 cm.
- A loose paper fire of that area peaks at about 8 to 22 kW.
